ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 white-to-black pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface, characterized by high-intensity white lobes and a low-intensity black central region and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral sections of both lobes. A low-intensity black region forms a central V-shape extending from the peduncle to the notch. A continuous low-intensity black border follows the entire outer perimeter. Significant low-intensity vertical mottling is present on the medial portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, increasing in density towards distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters at both distal tips; scattered high-intensity circular punctations within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel, low-intensity linear tracks on the high-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue growth/scarring at both distal tips, protruding slightly from the geometric fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark vertical streaking pattern on the interior white portion of the left lobe.
